Written by `npm run verify:cdn` (scripts/verify-cdn-snippets.mjs): verified. Install.astro renders a CDN snippet only when `verified` holds a passing entry for the exact versions shown.

@johnhenry/a2a-query.summary: Library entries (., ./react, ./testing) are plain ESM with no Node built-ins; @a2a-js/sdk comes in through the import map. Only the a2a-query-codegen CLI is Node.

@johnhenry/a2a-query-tanstack.summary: React hooks over a2a-query; react and @tanstack/react-query come in through the import map (react via jsDelivr's /+esm build, since it ships CommonJS).

@johnhenry/acp-query.summary: Plain ESM with no Node built-ins; @agentclientprotocol/sdk comes in through the import map.

@johnhenry/agent-query-core.summary: Plain ESM, no dependencies; ./react needs react.

@johnhenry/aimatey-backend.summary: Plain ESM, every provider subpath loads in a browser. Calling a remote provider from a page is still subject to that provider's CORS policy and puts your API key in the page.

@johnhenry/aimatey-core.summary: Plain ESM (an ESM and a CJS build); its three @johnhenry/aimatey-* dependencies come in through the import map.

@johnhenry/aimatey-frontend.summary: Plain ESM, every adapter subpath loads in a browser.

@johnhenry/aimatey-middleware.summary: Plain ESM. ./opentelemetry imports the @opentelemetry/* peers lazily, so map them only if you use it.

@johnhenry/aimatey-middleware-andbox.summary: Plain ESM, no Node built-ins. @johnhenry/andbox is a peer you add yourself.

@johnhenry/andbox.summary: Plain ESM, no dependencies, no Node built-ins.

@johnhenry/apple-foundation-models.summary: A Node bridge to a Swift helper built at install time: child_process, net, fs, readline. macOS only (`"os": ["darwin"]`).

@johnhenry/canvas-fx.summary: Plain ESM custom elements with no dependencies. global.mjs registers every element.

@johnhenry/css-signals.summary: Plain ESM and CSS files, no dependencies.

@johnhenry/data-plot.summary: Plain ESM custom elements with no dependencies. global.mjs registers every element.

@johnhenry/dialback.summary: The root imports node:http, node:crypto and ws's server. ./browsermesh imports node:events, so it loads raw only in Node; esm.sh's events polyfill gets it to import.

@johnhenry/domkit.summary: Source ESM. These docs describe domkit 0.1.0, whose module layout differs from the 0.0.4 on npm, so no CDN snippet is generated until 0.1.0 is published.

@johnhenry/ecmanim.summary: The root, ./browser, ./browser-three, ./authoring, ./studio and ./physics/* load in a browser. Optional renderers (three, mathjax-full, mp4-muxer, …) are imported lazily, so map them only if you use them. ./node and ./service (ffmpeg, worker_threads, http) are Node.

@johnhenry/fileable.summary: The root renders to disk (node:fs, child_process, zlib) and is Node-only. ./browser and the JSX runtimes load in a browser.

@johnhenry/hostable.summary: The root, the JSX runtimes and the Deno/Bun/Cloudflare adapters are Fetch-API code that loads in a browser (a service worker, say); servable's #imports resolve through an import-map scope. ./adapters/node needs node:http.

@johnhenry/html-modules.summary: The bootstrap, runtime, compiler and safe-fragment bridge load in a browser. ./dev (a node:http dev server), ./vite and the html-module CLI are Node.

@johnhenry/isomorphic-jj.summary: The root and ./browser load in a browser. isomorphic-git (a peer) and its CommonJS dependencies come in through jsDelivr's /+esm builds; @isomorphic-git/lightning-fs is optional. The isojj CLI is Node.

@johnhenry/jth.summary: The jth CLI and compiler driver: esbuild, fs, child_process.

@johnhenry/jth-stdlib.summary: Plain ESM; jth-runtime and jth-types come in through the import map.

@johnhenry/laya.summary: The root loads in a browser; its #io import resolves to the browser build through an import-map scope. Pair it with @johnhenry/backend-webgpu (or backend-cpu), which it imports lazily.

@johnhenry/leserve.summary: An HTTP server on node:http/https and ws. A few helper subpaths (./body, ./compose, ./auth) import cleanly in a browser, but the package exists to run a Node server.

@johnhenry/letterpress.summary: The router and ./rewrite are runtime-agnostic and load in a browser. ./fs, the filesystem router, needs node:fs.

@johnhenry/math-plus-tensor-core.summary: Plain ESM; @johnhenry/math-plus-special comes in through the import map.

@johnhenry/math-prototype-patch.summary: Plain ESM; @johnhenry/math comes in through the import map.

@johnhenry/mcp-gate.summary: The package has a "browser" export condition whose build carries only the policy helpers (compilePolicy, policyListFilter, redact, validateGateConfig). createGate, the proxy itself, and the mcp-gate CLI are Node.

@johnhenry/mcp-query.summary: Every entry loads in a browser except ./transports, the stdio transport (node:process, node:stream, cross-spawn). ./otel loads from esm.sh but not raw from jsDelivr: @opentelemetry/api's ESM build uses extensionless relative imports.

@johnhenry/mcp-query-tanstack.summary: React hooks over mcp-query; the MCP client SDK, react and @tanstack/react-query come in through the import map.

@johnhenry/mport.summary: The router (., ./core, ./firefox) is plain ESM with no dependencies. ./node, ./vite, ./rollup and the CLI read and write files.

@johnhenry/oat-protocol.summary: Plain ESM; cbor-x and @noble/* come in through the import map.

@johnhenry/oat-receiver.summary: Plain ESM; jsqr (CommonJS) comes in through jsDelivr's /+esm build.

@johnhenry/oat-sender.summary: Plain ESM; qrcode (CommonJS) comes in through jsDelivr's /+esm build.

@johnhenry/objectify.summary: A CLI on better-sqlite3 (a native addon), fs and child_process.

@johnhenry/packfile.summary: ./browser and ./blob-preview load in a browser. The root and ./compat, ./cache, ./hash, ./compression, ./web-bundle use node:fs, node:crypto or zlib.

@johnhenry/raijin-da.summary: Plain ESM. viem (peer) and fflate (optional) are imported only by the features that need them.

@johnhenry/safe-fragment.summary: Plain ESM. dompurify is imported lazily (only without Element.setHTML), and a raw CDN cannot resolve that bare import, so the import map includes it.

@johnhenry/semantic-chunker.summary: The chunker and ./embed/xenova load in a browser. ./embed/ollama imports node:fs.

@johnhenry/servable.summary: The root (it has a "browser" export condition), the JSX runtimes and the Deno/Bun/Cloudflare adapters load in a browser; its #imports resolve through an import-map scope. ./adapters/node needs node:http.

@johnhenry/servant.summary: Controls a Node HTTP server: node:http, node:https, node:stream, ws.

@johnhenry/temporals.summary: Plain ESM; temporal-polyfill (a peer) comes in through the import map.

@johnhenry/webwire.summary: Converts between Node's http objects and Fetch API Request/Response. Some subpaths import in a browser, but they only make sense with Node objects.

@johnhenry/window-algebra.summary: Plain ESM, no dependencies; every entry point loads in a browser.

@johnhenry/wsh.summary: Plain ESM, no dependencies; @noble/post-quantum is an optional, lazily imported extra.
